convert_checkpoint_to_model: convert a trained checkpoint to a saved Stable Diffusion model pipeline with LoRA weights
load_checkpoint_weights: load accelerator checkpoint weights into a trained unet model with LoRA parameters
save_lora_weights: save LoRA layer weights from a trained unet using diffusers LoraLoaderMixin
build_stable_diffusion_pipeline: build a CustomStableDiffusionPipeline from pretrained base model and trained unet components
run_checkpoint_conversion_cli: run the checkpoint-to-model conversion via CLI with tyro argument parsing
